crossRefs.note: The sun rises, and they steal away, and lie down in their dens.

translations.web: Then the animals take cover, and remain in their dens.
translations.bsb: The wild animals enter their lairs; they settle down in their dens.
translations.kjv: Then the beasts go into dens, and remain in their places.
translations.asv: Then the beasts go into coverts, And remain in their dens.
